It was @dynamic here before this commit and is not now, because a setting that needs no hardware is code this port can write. What the tracker does with either is a separate question this file does not answer: it matches features between consecutive frames and reports planes, it names neither ARReferenceImage nor ARImageAnchor, and no image anchor is ever reported. The release carries all four accessors in this class's own instance list (detectionImages 0x1af1684fc, setDetectionImages: 0x1af16850c, maximumNumberOfTrackedImages 0x1af168558, setMaximumNumberOfTrackedImages: 0x1af166620)
entries.effect: the number the caller set, and 0 when none was. The tracker does not read it - it reports no image anchor - so the number limits nothing here, which the row says rather than claiming a limit
